description: Oscillatory shear measurements of poly(D,L-lactide) probe elastic storage and viscous loss across frequency and temperature. A single system must explain both response channels with the same relaxation times, elastic strengths and thermal shift. Entire temperature sweeps are held out.
independent_unit: temperature/frequency sweeps within one polymer batch
limitations: One polymer batch; temperature sweeps are condition blocks, not independent specimens
Both response channels are fitted jointly; this is not a held-out cross-response confirmation
No target-derived tan-delta, complex viscosity or other measured modulus is a permitted input
Retrospective temperature interpolation, not proof of molecular mechanism or new constitutive laws

evidence.scope: Registered source terms, verified against source record; no external review claim

title: Polymer relaxation: coupled storage and loss
